name: memory_extract
source: Synthetic messages, hand-written for plan section 4.3. No real user data. Labels are the author's judgement, not model output. Each item is an independent synthetic example; items do not describe one consistent person and need not agree with each other.
task: One user message per call. The model answers with the PromptKind.memory contract (engine.dart memoryGrammar): {"remember":false} or {"remember":true,"memory":"...","category":"preference|fact|person"}.

label_semantics.expected_remember: true = a durable personal fact, preference or person about the user should be stored. false = nothing should be stored. null = no single correct answer, or time-bound (not scored); excluded from scoring.
label_semantics.category: Required (preference | fact | person) when expected_remember is true. null otherwise.
label_semantics.kind: Descriptive bucket for reporting. Not used for scoring.
label_semantics.duplicate_of: Id of an earlier item this message restates. The duplicate keeps the original's expected_remember and category. Storage dedupe is separate; the extractor is still expected to answer for the message itself. null for all other items.
label_semantics.required_keywords: Optional. List of groups; each group needs at least one case-insensitive substring hit in the stored memory text. Present only on items where the required content is objectively clear.
label_semantics.independence: Items are scored one at a time and are independent of each other. Do not assume they describe one person (e.g. me-002, me-007 and me-015 name different cities; me-010 and me-016 name different languages).

kinds.durable_fact: Stable fact about the user (identity, work, study, health, possessions, history).
kinds.preference: Stable like, dislike or habit of the user.
kinds.person: Named person in the user's life, with their relation or role.
kinds.unsafe_instruction: Message tries to make the assistant obey, adopt or store a rule, role or command. Must not be stored as memory.
kinds.temporary: Transient state, one-off event or appointment (today, this week, passing feeling). Not extracted as a suggestion. Time-bound storage with expiry is handled by 1.4 on explicit saves. Appointments and meetings belong in tasks or reminders, not memory.
kinds.negation: Negated statement. Durable negations are stored with the negation kept; transient negations are not stored.
kinds.ambiguous: Unclear whether it is a durable fact about the user. expected_remember is null.
kinds.duplicate: Restates an earlier item in this file (see duplicate_of).
kinds.chitchat: Greeting, thanks, question to the assistant, one-off request to the assistant, or small talk. Nothing about the user to store.
kinds.time_bound: Real personal fact limited to a known period (e.g. 'until Friday'). Not scored (expected_remember null). Storage with expiry is handled by 1.4 on explicit saves, not by extraction.

notes.me-014: Passes the temporary-phrase check only because of the plural 's' in 'Thursdays'. Keep the wording unless that check changes.
notes.me-031: Hard case: contains 'meetings', which the extraction instructions tell the model to ignore. Still labelled true.
